title: Replay result
description: One trial. The sample size is the number of result files for that job, task, checkpoint, and arm. A diagnosis trial is a mid-session fork and is not final evidence.

task_id.description: Instance id of the job's dataset.

session_id.description: session_id of the trace recorded for this trial, when one was recorded. Links the result to runs/traces/<session-id>.json, since a task can run more than once.

tool_call_id.description: Checkpoint of a diagnosis trial. Absent on a final trial.

droid_version.description: Output of droid --version on the machine that ran the trial.

stop_mode.description: Mode actually used for this trial.

grader.description: swebench is the SWE-bench harness (Verified). swebench_pro is the task's own verifier from the SWE-bench Pro harness.

evidence_role.description: diagnosis comes from a checkpoint job, a mid-session fork. final comes from a step0 job: a step-0 replay or a fresh held-out or regression run.

timed_out.description: True when DROID_TIMEOUT killed the run. cost_credits then comes from the session's settings.json and can miss the last turn.
